title: JANUS POSS-I — Public-Only Independent Reconstruction Cohort
purpose: Replace dependence on request-only VASCO bytes with a fully public, independently constructed POSS-I cohort whose candidate catalog, plate/tile exposure, astrometric corrections, hashes, and source lineage can be reproduced by any third party.

execution_route_change.old_primary_dependency: Unpublished/request-only 107,875-source VASCO catalog and associated daily SPSS data.
execution_route_change.new_primary_route: Independent public reconstruction using the pinned poss1-plate-slice public release plus public plate headers and independent open nuclear calendars.
execution_route_change.important_boundary: The 122,820-row open cohort is not claimed to be the same sample as the closed 107,875-row cohort. Raw count agreement is neither required nor expected; the target is transport of the statistical association under an independently generated, auditable selection function.

pinned_open_cohort.row_semantics: A row is a POSS-I red-plate source surviving the release's catalog/morphology/veto/dedup chain and absent from the modern catalogs checked. It is not by itself a verified physical transient, UAP, spacecraft, or non-human object.

why_this_route_is_methodologically_stron: The exact candidate and tile-manifest bytes are publicly downloadable and hash-pinned.
Plate identity is controlled by a plate-addressed full-scan workflow rather than delegated to a position-dependent archive cutout choice.
The pipeline publishes its candidate-selection code and an independence audit showing that unpublished catalogs are not inputs.
The current release documents and repairs concrete astrometric and veto failures instead of silently absorbing them into the catalog.
Exposure can be reconstructed from the actual processed-tile manifest and per-plate FITS metadata rather than treating non-observed calendar days as zero-candidate observing opportunities.

wcs_two_solution_issue.context: The public reconstruction reports disagreement between DSS astrometric solutions on a substantial plate subset and repaired a severe near-pole/RA-wrap refit failure.
wcs_two_solution_issue.release_repair: Eight defective tiles containing 12,273 rows in the superseded build yielded only 30 rows after astrometric repair.
wcs_two_solution_issue.janus_rule: Only the pinned repaired 2026-08-14 release is admitted for the primary open cohort. Superseded 2026-08-13 counts are negative-control provenance, not input.

veto_coverage_issue.context: A prior HEALPix cone-query implementation left portions of the reference-catalog veto incomplete and inflated candidates. The current release includes an explicit Gaia-contamination invariant.
veto_coverage_issue.janus_rule: An open cohort release is admissible only with its invariant/verification receipts and content hashes.

gaia_refit_circularity.context: The released coordinates include a Gaia-based smooth per-tile refit before Gaia is also used as a veto. The upstream project reports direct comparison against Gaia, PS1 and USNO-B and no Gaia-specific excess at the veto threshold.
gaia_refit_circularity.janus_rule: Retain this as an explicit provenance covariate/sensitivity rather than treating corrected coordinates as raw photographic astrometry.

open_data_acquisition.candidate_catalog: Pinned upstream stage_S0.csv.gz; expected decompressed SHA-256 is frozen above.
open_data_acquisition.tile_to_plate_binding: Pinned upstream tile_manifest.csv.gz; 31,458 processed tiles bind tile_id to plate_id.
open_data_acquisition.plate_observation_metadata: Read DATE-OBS, EXPOSURE, REGION and related identity keywords from the public IRSA DSS1 plate-addressed FITS headers. Full 374-MB image payloads are not required for the temporal association test.
open_data_acquisition.plate_header_efficiency: Stream only the initial FITS header blocks for 642 plates; do not download hundreds of gigabytes merely to recover dates/exposure metadata.
open_data_acquisition.dss_context: POSS-I E is survey code XE; STScI documents 936 survey plates in the full survey, while the pinned independent cohort processes 642 plates. These populations must not be conflated.

exposure_contract.why_proxy_not_deg2: A nominal 60x60 arcmin tile must not be silently assumed to contribute exactly one square degree of valid, unique effective footprint after clipping, overlap and plate geometry.
exposure_contract.future_geometry_sensitivity: Compute exact non-overlapping valid sky area per processed tile from WCS footprints and rerun with geometric deg2-minute exposure.
exposure_contract.forbidden_relabel: exposure_tile_min may not be called deg2_min.

nuclear_calendar_strategy.literal_124_calendar: Still valuable for historical replication but no longer a blocker for the public-only primary route.
nuclear_calendar_strategy.open_control_source: Public structured SIPRI/IAEA-derived nuclear-explosion table, frozen by byte hash at execution time.

frozen_open_variants.strict: USA/USSR/UK tests in the study window with types AIRDROP, TOWER, SURFACE, ATMOSPH, BARGE, BALLOON, ROCKET or SHIP; exclude UW/SHAFT/TUNNEL/CRATER.
frozen_open_variants.broad: Same as strict but include CRATER as a preregistered sensitivity definition.

nuclear_calendar_strategy.anti_p_hacking_rule: Both open calendar definitions are specified before inspecting beta_nuclear; neither may be promoted post hoc merely because it gives a smaller p-value.
nuclear_calendar_strategy.historical_comparison: The 124/125/126 discrepancy remains tracked separately. Open-control results are labelled by their own row/date definitions and are never called an exact reproduction of the original 124-date SPSS calendar.

primary_open_test.grain: one row per processed POSS-I plate within 1949-11-19 through 1957-04-28
primary_open_test.model: Negative Binomial NB2 with estimated dispersion; observation-date clustered covariance when sufficient repeated dates exist; Poisson sensitivity retained.
primary_open_test.primary_question: Does a residual nuclear-window incidence-rate effect remain in a completely public, independently constructed POSS-I candidate cohort after conditioning on actual processed exposure and smooth temporal structure?

hypothesis_interpretation.H0_schedule_artifact: After exposure and preregistered temporal/artifact controls, beta_nuclear is compatible with zero.
hypothesis_interpretation.H1_baseline_plus_trigger: A non-zero baseline candidate population exists and beta_nuclear remains non-zero after the frozen controls.
hypothesis_interpretation.H1_claim_ceiling: Even a surviving association would not show that candidates are physical sky transients, UAP, non-human objects, or caused by nuclear detonations. It would establish transport of a temporal association into an independent public selection pipeline.

admission_gates.pass: 122,820-row stage and 31,458-row tile manifest match pinned decompressed SHA-256 values
all stage tile_ids map unambiguously to the 642 public plate IDs
all 642 plate IDs yield parseable public FITS DATE-OBS and positive EXPOSURE with matching REGION identity
open strict and broad calendar bytes/definitions frozen before beta inspection
plate-day matrices have positive exposure_tile_min, zero/positive candidate counts and deterministic nuclear-window flags
NB2 primary plus preregistered calendar/window sensitivities complete from frozen matrices
results compared with Hayes and with the historical closed-sample reports without treating non-equivalent catalogs as pooled observations
only an explicitly admitted result artifact may change current-authority; this design artifact does not
